contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and FND-0098 does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001; it is compatible with THM-0005 (c(6)=5 so n=6 needs residual geometry) and with RED-0001 retaining (6,6). Primary checks: (1) Brill–Noether ρ(6,1,4)=0 and classical count that a general genus-6 curve carries exactly five g^1_4’s (Hoff–Knutsen arXiv:2001.07952 citing ACGH85 p.209ff), so the forgetful map from tetragonal/Hurwitz data remembering γ to unmarked moduli is generically 5-to-1; openness of the balanced splitting stratum does not restore injectivity. (2) SRC-0004/Canning–Larson Lemma 10.6 supplies deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f and the CE obstruction vanishing setup used to define L=W_5⊗ω^{-1}, but does not identify W_5≅ω_C^2(-D); that residual identification remains the undischarged GAP-Z-W5D named in corroborated FND-0073, and is the standard route recovering the pencil as |ω⊗L^{-1}|. (3) Source/target/stack hygiene aligns with and does not duplicate FND-0052 (balanced model is open piece), FND-0060/FND-0064 (stack Aut and ordered Conf_6 vs unordered Div^6), and FND-0091 (mono of balanced Z only embeds the balanced open piece, not an isomorphism of full CE failure). Distinct from FND-0058 (constant h^0 for P^2 fibre dimension) and FND-0073 (h^0(L) stratification without GAP-Z-W5D): complementary constraints on the same residual gap. Mild wording caveat: ‘equivalent’ is slightly strong—recovery is necessary for mono, while full mono also needs the stated source/target/full-faithfulness package—but the obstruction content for C66-GEO-Z is load-bearing and verified. Promote candidate to corroborated; do not merge.
